name: 78250 · San Antonio, TX
findings: ZIP 78250 (San Antonio) has 78 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 78250 (San Antonio) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 78250 (San Antonio) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 36% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 72 organizations here; 33% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
